subheading: Try new hairstyles and hair colors on your own photo with an editable ComfyUI workflow that keeps your face exactly as it is.
extendedDescription:
The point of an ai hairstyle changer is answering one question honestly: would this cut actually suit me? The Hairstyle Changer workflow on this page edits only the hair in your photo. Your face, skin tone, lighting, and background stay untouched, so the result reads as you with a new style rather than a stranger with your outfit.

Upload a portrait, describe the change, and run it. The same workflow handles cuts and colors: a bob, curtain bangs, long layers, a buzz cut, or the same style you have now in copper, platinum, or black. Because the color change rides on the same edit, you can preview a cut and a color together in one pass, which is exactly the decision you face before a salon appointment.

Like everything on this site, it is a normal ComfyUI workflow, not a locked app. Run it on Comfy Cloud in the browser with no install, or load it locally. Re-run with different prompts to build a set of options from the same photo, compare them side by side, and save the full-resolution results with no watermark to bring to your stylist.

howToUse: Open the Hairstyle Changer on Comfy Cloud with the Try button, or load the workflow in your local ComfyUI.
Upload a clear, front-facing portrait photo.
Describe the hairstyle or color you want to try.
Run the workflow and check that the face and lighting stayed true.
Re-run with other styles to build a set of options, then save your favorites at full resolution.

metaDescription: Try new hairstyles and hair colors on your own photo with the Hairstyle Changer workflow in ComfyUI. Face and lighting stay untouched. Runs in the browser.

faqItems.question: Will my face still look like me?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The workflow edits the hair region and leaves the face, skin tone, lighting, and background unchanged, which is what makes the preview useful.

faqItems.question: Can it change hair color as well as the style?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The same workflow handles cuts, colors, or both in one edit, so you can preview a new shade on your current style or on a new cut.

faqItems.question: What kind of photo works best?
faqItems.answer: A clear, well-lit, front-facing portrait where the hair is fully visible gives the most accurate preview.

faqItems.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqItems.answer: No. The Try button runs the workflow on Comfy Cloud in the browser. You can also download it and run it in a local ComfyUI.
